newsitem.title: USA: Health Management to pay $7.2 mln in pact.
newsitem.headline: Health Management to pay $7.2 mln in pact.

text.p: Health Management Inc said on Friday that it agreed to pay $7.2 million under a settlement of a shareholder lawsuit.
The payment will take place upon the consummation of a merger with Transworld Home HealthCare Inc, the company said.
A hearing for final court approval is currently scheduled for March 14, 1997, the company said.

Under the merger agreement, Transworld will purchase 8,964,292 newly issued shares of Health Management, which will constitute 49 percent of Health Management and will be granted an option to purchase an additional two percent stake.

As previously announced, Transworld and Health Management have agreed to merge and the stockholders of Health Management will receive cash consideration equal to $2.00 per share, subject to certain conditions, including government approvals, the company said.
